0022600206.text: The Raptors (5-4, 4th in the Atlantic and 6th in the East) host the Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 7th in the West) in Toronto's 10th game of the season, with Toronto 2-1 at home and riding a one-game win streak while Memphis is 4-0 on the road and has lost its last three. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 128-96 win in Memphis on April 3, 2026. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness).
